insights: The design system uses CSS variables extensively (--bg-soft, --text-primary, --border-soft) enabling seamless dark/light mode switching with prefers-color-scheme media queries.
Button interactions favor opacity changes over background shifts for primary CTAs, creating a subtle but cohesive hover feedback pattern.
The composer input area uses a sophisticated tab switching mechanism with animated sliding pill indicators, suggesting a polished micro-interaction focus throughout the UI.
